units.source_text: 弁姐看了这诗说道：“请勿侮辱我们！

en.t: Lady Ben read the poem and said, "Please do not insult us!

units.source_text: 我说的是野宿在别的郊原上，不是我们留你宿！”

en.t: I meant spending the night out on some other moor, not that we would keep you here overnight!"

units.source_text: 薰大将略微说了几句无关紧要的话，侍女们希望他再说下去。

en.t: General Kaoru made a few slight, inconsequential remarks, and the waiting women hoped he would go on speaking.

units.source_text: 但他已准备离去，说道：“我只管拦住道路，太任性了，现在放你们走吧。

en.t: But he was already preparing to leave and said, "I have only been blocking your way; it was terribly selfish of me. I will let you go now.

units.source_text: 今天你们特别怕羞，东避西躲，定然有个缘故吧？”

en.t: Today you are especially bashful, dodging this way and that; surely there must be some reason for it?"

units.source_text: 说罢就站起身来走出去。

en.t: With that, he stood up and walked out.

units.source_text: 有几个侍女想道：“他以为我们都是像弁姐一样不怕羞的人，真冤枉了！”

en.t: Some of the waiting women thought, "He imagines we are all as unbashful as Lady Ben. What an injustice!"
